text: The authors append the kept debate transcript to each weak-model input and fine-tune a small pretrained model on these augmented samples with ground-truth labels; because transcripts are long, they train an ensemble of weak models, either debate ensembles (each member uses a transcript from a different debate sampling seed) or finetune ensembles (shared transcript, different fine-tuning seeds), with four members by default.
title: Weak model ensembles trained on debate-augmented samples (debate vs finetune ensembles)
